exposure: 1 ml/kg BW/hour of hydroxyethyl starch (HES) 6% with 5 mg/hour of furosemide
cohort: This study included forty patients diagnosed with pre-eclampsia who underwent elective or emergency cesarean section.
finding: The administration of colloid and furosemide in parturients with pre-eclampsia resulted in better hemodynamic profiles and slower reduction in plasma albumin levels compared to crystalloid administration.
